instruction: Can you help me stream this YouTube video using the VLC player? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CevxZvSJLk8

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation of VLC streaming task with a different YouTube video URL (Katy Perry - Roar). Uses the same evaluator pattern (is_vlc_playing with url type). Instruction uses 'help me stream' phrasing while maintaining the same task structure and difficulty.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic correctly verifies the instruction requirement: streaming a specific YouTube video in VLC
Getter (get_vlc_playing_info) appropriately fetches VLC status via HTTP interface and returns the XML file path
Metric (is_vlc_playing) correctly checks both: (1) VLC is in 'playing' state, and (2) the URL matches the expected YouTube URL
Metric implements robust URL matching with multiple methods: direct URL match, filename-based match for HLS streams, and domain+path comparison
Parameter handling is correct: metric receives the rules dictionary directly when expected.type='rule'
Complete coverage: all requirements in the instruction are verified
Data flow is logically correct: getter extracts VLC state → metric validates playing status and URL → returns score
